answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. A cipher of per-task receipts records who did what, and the karst of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the pearl of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
